covered: re-checked prior r3 agent-copilot-cli.json findings: still open, not repeated below

findings.claim: The r3 decision for Q11 says 'one named project source per host (Codex, Copilot CLI, Remote-WSL); doctor reports a missing source; no fallback chain', but the ADR text only repeats this sentence and never names the single source for Copilot CLI. The code it must replace is a two-step fallback, not a single source.
findings.evidence: ADR-0007:74 'one named project source per host ... no fallback chain' (no table row follows); cm-main src/adapters/copilot-cli/index.ts:127 and :152 'projectDir: typeof input.cwd === "string" && input.cwd ? input.cwd : process.cwd()' — this is a 2-step fallback (hook cwd, else process.cwd()), and index.ts:113-114 getProjectDir() is a 3rd, unconditional process.cwd() path used elsewhere in the adapter.
findings.fix: Add the missing table row: Copilot CLI project source = PreToolUse/PostToolUse payload field `cwd`. If `cwd` is absent, doctor reports a missing source (owner's own rule) instead of the adapter silently substituting process.cwd(). Remove the getProjectDir() process.cwd() path or restrict it to a context where no hook payload exists yet (e.g. SessionStart), and say so explicitly.
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY 9f34c6f1 2026-06-21 'Add GitHub Copilot CLI + Antigravity CLI (agy) support' (#787). ORIGINAL_INTENT: no comment justifies the process.cwd() fallback; it was added defensively alongside the sessionId fallback chain (index.ts:105-107 comment 'kept only as a defensive fallback'). REGRESSION_RISK: if v2 keeps this fallback it directly violates the Q11 'no fallback chain' decision while claiming to satisfy it; if v2 removes it silently without naming the replacement in the ADR, hook-driven project scoping breaks for any PreToolUse event Copilot CLI sends without a cwd field. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: one resolver, payload cwd only, doctor-visible failure on absence, no process.cwd() substitution anywhere in the Copilot CLI adapter path.

findings.claim: The E2E matrix requires a live Copilot CLI run with COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN (a fine-grained PAT) and states CI's own GITHUB_TOKEN does not work, but the owner decision is keyless local harness with no API keys for tests. No doc resolves this conflict for Copilot CLI specifically.
findings.evidence: TECH-SPEC.md:365 'Copilot CLI | required | ... | COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN (fine-grained PAT, Copilot Requests; CI GITHUB_TOKEN does not work) | flag'; owner decision 'no API keys for tests, keyless local harness' (DECISIONS context, repeated in task brief).
findings.fix: Either mark Copilot CLI live E2E as owner-run-only (manual, outside the keyless CI harness) and say so in TECH-SPEC, or specify a stub/record-replay fixture path (hook-payload fixture, already named at TECH-SPEC.md:370 for VS Code Copilot) that needs no PAT, and make that the default CI path.
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY: new v2 text, no v1 precedent (v1 had no automated Copilot CLI E2E). REGRESSION_RISK: CI either silently skips Copilot CLI coverage or leaks a PAT into CI secrets, contradicting the keyless-harness decision. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: default CI path must not require a credential; a credentialed live run, if kept, must be opt-in and clearly out of the main CI loop.
